bead.title: bench-runner: amend SD-011 with shell-runner progress event taxonomy (or file SD-011-addendum)
bead.description:
AR-2026-05-17-repo finding. SD-011 (canonical progress events) describes DDx/Fizeau native streams; it does not govern what the new ./benchmark bash runner emits for operator visibility. plan-2026-05-15 §PR 1d defines the operator contract but does not standardize the runner-to-operator progress format (raw logs vs structured events vs new shell-specific format). Before PR D (Node collector) lands, decide the contract and amend SD-011 (or add SD-011-addendum-shell-events.md).

Source review: fizeau-a15106ab.
bead.acceptance: SD-011 (or a referenced addendum) defines: the progress-event shape the bash runner emits, where formatting/structuring happens (runner vs collector vs website), and how it relates to the existing canonical-progress-events taxonomy.
